resolution: Fixed the compiled-game gray fallback for painted wall stencils by making the no-JS Zig loader recognize the cutout-stencil material recipe, rebuild its RGBA tile from the shipped mask/color data, and install it through the same keyed material texture path used by decal materials. The earlier alpha-pass routing stays in place so transparent stencil pixels do not write an opaque wall face.
